# One Touch Supplies

> > One Touch Supplies is a UK-based supplier of professional hygiene products, PPE, cleaning supplies, and beauty salon essentials.

One Touch Supplies offers a comprehensive range of products including Dettol and Sanisafe antibacterial wipes, disposable gloves, bin liners, and professional beauty supplies. The site serves businesses and professionals across the UK with cleaning, hygiene, and personal protective equipment.

## Key Topics

- Antibacterial wipes
- Surface cleaning
- Disposable gloves
- PPE (Personal Protective Equipment)
- Dettol products
- Sanisafe products
- Beauty salon supplies
- Bin liners and waste management
- UK shipping
- Food-safe cleaning
- Laundry sanitiser
- Vinyl gloves
- Professional hygiene
- Commercial cleaning supplies
